vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Pick and identify beekeeping equipment using approved product codes and listed dimensions.
requirements.zh: 依据获批产品代码及所列尺寸拣选并识别养蜂设备。

requirements.en: Reconcile sealed packs and loose components without treating components as complete assemblies.
requirements.zh: 核对密封包及散装组件，不将组件视为完整组装件。

requirements.en: Prepare dispatched and reserved orders with traceable customer notifications.
requirements.zh: 准备发货及预留订单，并保留可追溯客户通知。

requirements.en: Handle routine till sales and direct specialist or refund questions to the responsible colleague.
requirements.zh: 处理常规收银销售，并将专业或退款问题转交负责同事。

requirements.en: Preferred: lead customer demonstrations of assembling wooden hive equipment.
requirements.zh: 优先：为客户主持木制蜂箱设备组装演示。
